entries.note: Albert 2006 (PMID 16648571, Mol Cancer Ther, Apr 2006) resolves; quote verbatim in the abstract. Prospective PD model, own model_id, no human readout in 2006: untested is right.

Wong 2009 (PMID 19720910, JCO, epub 2009-08-31) resolves; quote verbatim in abstract. DCE-MRI permeability is downstream physiology of the model's VEGF-permeability readout; mixed solid-tumour phase 1 admissible as healthy volunteers are. Abstract read only.
Albert 2006 quote verbatim in abstract; the 0.08 ug/mL >=7 h threshold was stated in 2006, before any human PK, so it is a prospective target, not post-hoc (#50). margin_stated false is right.

entries.rule: decision 4 (dose: reached AND sufficient; cases #32/#80 leave linifanib's CRC efficacy untested, so case 2 cannot apply) and rule 3 (no source states the exposure ratio)
entries.note: Arithmetic checks (17.5 mg/d over 2.7 L/h = 0.27 ug/mL > 0.08) but no source states it; sufficiency rests on famitinib, which has no exposure target, and linifanib's CRC trials are untested under #32/#80. Untested; folds into the 2006 opener (decision 7).
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 4: dose needs reached and sufficient; case 2 needs the drug to have worked, and linifanib's CRC efficacy is untested (#32/#80, drafter agrees). Famitinib has no model exposure target, so cannot supply 'reached'. Never fully compared: untested (decision 8).

entries.note: Albert 2006 quote verbatim in abstract (colon xenograft ED50 1.5-5 mg/kg); no CRC patient data in 2006. Abstract names no colon line, as the draft says.

Xu 2017 (PMID 29273089, epub 2017-12-22; NCT01762293 has no posted results) resolves, quote verbatim, PFS primary met vs placebo. Chan 2017 is untested under #32/#53 (missed single-arm ORR gate, source claims activity), O'Neil 2014 under #80. Both phase 3s still unreported.

Franklin 2009 (PMID 19255283, JPET, epub 2009-03-02) resolves; quote verbatim in abstract. Status untested at first use holds, but retrodiction must be true: the abstract says the study was run because VEGFR inhibition 'is also associated with reversible hypertension' clinically.

entries.rule: decision 10 (post-hoc model reproducing a known harm is retro, never same) and decision 7 (earliest admissible comparison)
entries.note: Chan 2017 quote verbatim, but the rat model post-dates and is motivated by known VEGFR-TKI hypertension (Franklin 2009 abstract; Wong 2009 grade-3 hypertension DLTs, cohort included colon cancer): retro, 2009. Even if not retro, year 2017 is wrong: NCT01365910 results posted 2014-08-26 list hypertension 20/30.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 10 with 12: on-target hypertension pools the mechanism, so the patient result is class-level (MET efficacy 6 ruling); Franklin 2009 states VEGFR-inhibitor hypertension was already clinical and models its control. Reproduces the known harm: retro, 2009.

entries.note: Jiang 2011 (PMID 21505059, JPET 338:134, epub 2011-04-19) resolves; quote and 'has undergone phase I and II clinical trials' verbatim in abstract. Untested opener at first use 2011 holds; lint line 68 bars retrodiction on it. JPET full text still a page shell.

entries.rule: decision 10 (post-hoc model reproducing the patient DCE-MRI drop is retro, never same); decision 7 (year = model epub 2011)
entries.note: Wong 2009 (PMID 19720910, JCO, epub 2009-08-31) resolves; quote verbatim in abstract. Model post-dates the patient result: retro 2011, class, downstream, direction_only all hold. Europe PMC finds no earlier ABT-869 preclinical DCE-MRI; Koh 2011 (PMID 21432928) is patient-side only.

Yu 2014 (PMID 25920197, Yao Xue Xue Bao 49:1684, Dec 2014, no DOI, Chinese) resolves; quote verbatim in the English abstract. In-silico opener untested at first use 2014; retrodiction false forced by lint, as the draft says.

entries.rule: decision 10 (human PK already measured: Zhou 2013, PMID 24043137, epub 2013-09-17, shared authors Chen X and Zhong D)
entries.note: Quote verbatim; 1.63/1.57 observed/predicted AUC supports within_2x and source_calls_it match ('successfully'). Retro 2014, not same. Abstract names no human dataset; the Zhou 2013 inference is reasonable at low confidence. See rule question on a PBPK retro with no efficacy target.

missing: NCT01365910 registry results record (tier 3, posted 2014-08-26, https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT01365910): hypertension in 20/30 linifanib CRC patients and ORR 0/30 against a >=15% target. The draft says the record does not itemise hypertension; it does. It dates the CRC-only safety comparison to 2014 and gives the efficacy patient_trials entry a quotable primary result.

No untracked model found. Europe PMC sweeps for (famitinib OR SHR1020), donafenib and (linifanib OR ABT-869) with colorectal/colon x xenograft/organoid/patient-derived/PDX terms return no CRC preclinical paper for any member (donafenib hits are all HCC); WebSearch likewise. Famitinib's and donafenib's own CRC models, if any, are unpublished, as the draft says.

FACT (NCT02390947, completed 2019-07, last update 2020-12-22) and the donafenib phase 3 (NCT02870582, completed 2020-04-30, last update 2022-11-29): no posted results, publication or press release found by WebSearch; the draft's 'unreported' stands. Famitinib + camrelizumab CRC basket (Innovation 2025, PMID 39872476) is a PD-1 combination: patient_trials at most, no status.

Models check (CHECKER_BRIEF_v3 / models): Europe PMC (ABT-869 OR linifanib) AND (DCE-MRI OR Ktrans), 73 hits, finds no untracked CRC model. Luo 2012 (PMID 22080168) is an orthotopic rat glioma DCE-MRI model, out of tile; Koh 2011 (PMID 21432928, same phase 1, PS fell >25.1% in late progressors) is patient-side and changes no status.
rule_questions: Dose: the model's exposure target was reached (by the drafter's arithmetic from published clearance and dose; no source states the ratio) but that drug's efficacy in the context is untested under #32/#80, while a sibling member with no exposure target won on PFS. Does decision 4 case 2 pool across members, or is the dose cell untested? The case table has no row for reached-with-efficacy-untested.

Chan 2017 (single-arm, missed ORR primary, conclusion 'linifanib has some anti-tumor activity', 63.5% SD, PFS 4.7 months): does that conclusion count as the source 'calling it a match' under #32, making it same + source_calls_it partial (product_in_model true, datable 2014 by the registry record) rather than untested? The track is same either way; the carrying drug and year change.
Population: does a biomarker-selected trial (KRAS-mutant only) count for an 'Unselected' context? The >=80% rule runs only from unselected trials to biomarker contexts.

Decision 10 keying: the harm was known for the class (VEGFR-TKI hypertension, 2005-2006) and for linifanib only from phase-1 conference reports when the rat telemetry model was run. Does class-level knowledge suffice to make the model a retrodiction? I applied it, on the Franklin 2009 abstract's own framing.

A primary ORR gate for a cytostatic class whose model predicted growth inhibition, not regression: #53 ('failed = the predicted effect was absent') makes the missed ORR a non-failure, but the efficacy rule's 'trial's primary endpoint' wording invites a contra. Worth stating explicitly.

Dose cell, PBPK track: Yu 2014 reproduced human famitinib exposure within 2-fold but set no effective-exposure target, so sufficiency is undetermined. Does decision 10 give retro on the reached half alone, or does decision 4 (reached AND sufficient) make a target-less PK model untested, as dose index 2 was adjudicated? I confirmed retro as drafted.

Openers of post-hoc models: lint (line 68) rejects retrodiction: true on any status but retro/contra, so the untested opener of a retrodiction model (engagement 3, dose 3, and safety 1) necessarily reads as prospective at first use; the safety index 1 verdict asked for the flag there, which lint would refuse. Decide whether openers carry the flag or the strip reads it from the next entry.
